instruction: Expand the exact-prompt choreography classifier and its negative tests to cover the full declared Git, release, and cleanup families, and constrain the phase-tool exception to declared invocations before resubmitting the frozen implementation for evaluation.

findings.summary: The exact-provider-input guard still permits Git and release/cleanup choreography outside repair-authorized episodes because its command-family patterns enumerate only selected subcommands.
